title: centaurea riaeana
intro: Centaurea riaeana, commonly known as the Pyrenean knapweed, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family, Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain, due to its therapeutic actions as an anti-inflammatory and analgesic agent. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea riaeana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, and further research is being conducted to confirm its efficacy and potential therapeutic applications.
